name: smart-tourism-platform
description: Pan-India tourism discovery and intelligence platform (SIH PS 25032).

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @smart-tourism/contracts && concurrently -n contracts,api,web -c gray,green,yellow "npm run dev -w @smart-tourism/contracts" "npm run dev -w @smart-tourism/api" "npm run dev -w @smart-tourism/web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @smart-tourism/contracts && npm run dev -w @smart-tourism/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w @smart-tourism/contracts && npm run dev -w @smart-tourism/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @smart-tourism/contracts && npm run build -w @smart-tourism/api && npm run build -w @smart-tourism/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @smart-tourism/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @smart-tourism/contracts && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:deploy && npm run db:seed
